text.description_html:
Laurey Cosmopolitan Oil Rubbed Bronze Chrome Cabinet Pull

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Cosmopolitan Cabinet Pull is available in a few sizes for small and large cabinet doors. The Cosmopolitan Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The sleek design is great for modern kitchen remodels. And it is easy to care for!

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Cosmopolitan Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 5 Sizes:

    LAU-73066:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4" (96mm)
    • Overall Length: 4-1/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73166:
    • C/C Length: 5" (128mm)
    • Total Length: 5-1/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73266:
    • C/C Length: 6-1/4" (160mm)
    • Total Length: 6-1/2"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73366:
    • C/C Length: 7-1/2" (192mm)
    • Total Length: 7-3/4"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"

    LAU-73466:
    • C/C Length: 10" (256mm)
    • Total Length: 10-1/2"
    • Width: 3/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/4"
